name: hessian_aot_leaves
scope: Opt-in explicitly selected native AD leaf package generated from authoritative compiler AO, integral, XC, grid, VV10 and ECP programs; the default inventory is partial. An explicit factorized integral schedule shares compiler-AD Hermite/Boys factors in one CUDA unit and groups exact selectors in host-only metadata units. Registry initialization uses a bounded loop over linked getters. Enumeration/source generation alone is not compiled-closure or molecular-endpoint qualification. Native host code retains borrowed-pointer launch validation and exact package-miss handling.
